mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 66 degrees, and if you look up tonight, the moon is in its first quarter phase and you can catch the space station passing from the northwest near Verona High School towards the northeast near Madison at 7:40 PM.

The city has announced that chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and parts of the Liberty Business Park, so expect some traffic control during those hours.

It is a busy weekend in the area with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival happening today, the Dane County Farmer's Market taking place today, and Bike the Barns coming up tomorrow at Badger Prairie County Park.
Looking at the recent police report, on September 5, officers responded to a peculiar incident where several vehicles had cheese slices placed on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
While Culver's of Verona remains open for other items until 10:30 PM, please note they are currently undergoing a remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
